This permit identifier determines which permit instrument's numeric limits and monitoring schedule are retrieved and matched to reported measurements; a different permit number would change which limits apply (A) and which monitoring requirements are evaluated (B).

The named applicant identifies the regulated facility; misattributing this segment to a different facility would apply the wrong discharge limits (A), the wrong monitoring obligations (B), and the wrong missing-evidence context for that facility's reported data (C).
